basic_details.short_information: Instrumentation Limited (IL) describes itself as one of the premier control valve manufacturers in the country. The company is looking for qualified and experienced professionals to be engaged on Fixed Term Employment at Palakkad, initially for 2 years, extendable by a further 2 years based on satisfactory performance and the requirement of the company. Register for Job Alerts

Candidates are advised to write their name and address on the reverse side of the Demand Draft. Applications without a proper Demand Draft (except PwD) will be summarily rejected.

age_limit.details: To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying. | Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination at the Instrumentation Limited Dispensary before joining, to ascertain medical fitness. Appointment is subject to a satisfactory medical report from the company's doctor. Candidates applying for technical positions with colour blindness will not be considered and need not apply.

Shortlisted candidates must produce all original documents at the time of document verification

from the concerned authorities as per company rules. Intimation about the written/practical test will be sent through e-mail and Speed Post. The minimum qualifying marks and test dates are not specified in the notification.

how_to_apply: There is no online submission for this recruitment. The company website is used only to download the application format. Applications sent by Fax, E-mail or by hand are not accepted.
Log in to the company website (www.ilpgt.com) and download the application format.

Fill in the prescribed application form completely, mentioning the name of the post applied for. A valid e-mail ID and mobile number must be entered, as communication about the written/practical test will be sent to them.
Affix a passport size photograph at the space provided.

Enclose the Demand Draft (Rs.500/- for General, EWS and OBC; Rs.250/- for SC/ST; no fee for PwD) and a set of self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates in proof of qualification, age, category, experience and so on.
Place everything in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for the post of ----------".
Send it by Ordinary Post, Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier so that it reaches the address below on or before 26.10.2026 (05.00 pm).
Candidates can apply for only one post, clearly mentioning the post applied for along with the DD and all other relevant documents.
A candidate who has applied once cannot alter the application under any circumstances.
Requests for change of mailing address, category or discipline declared in the application will not be entertained.
Candidates are advised to keep the e-mail ID active for at least one year and to check e-mail regularly. The company will not be responsible for bounced e-mails.
All relevant original certificates must be produced at the time of the written/practical test.

Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/PWD/Ex-Servicemen/Minority/EWS categories must enclose a copy of the certificate issued by the Competent Authority. The category must be filled in carefully, as it cannot be changed later.

content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Age Limit
content_sections.text: To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying. Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination at the Instrumentation Limited Dispensary before joining, to ascertain medical fitness. content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid by Demand Draft (DD) only, enclosed with the prescribed application. The notification states that no other mode of payment is acceptable. The Demand Draft must be an account payee DD drawn in favour of Instrumentation Limited, by any Scheduled Bank, payable at Palakkad. Candidates are advised to write their name and address on the reverse side of the Demand Draft. Applications without a proper Demand Draft (except PwD) will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Salary and Benefits
content_sections.text: All the advertised posts carry the pay scale Rs.14700-86000. Selected candidates are placed at the minimum of the scale of the grade for which they are appointed. The notification states that tenure-based personnel are not entitled to any allowance or benefits other than those indicated in the remuneration/pay scale and leave provisions above. The recruitment is on Fixed Term Employment (FTE) basis, initially for 2 years. It can be extended by a further 2 years (maximum period of 4 years) at the discretion of the company, based on requirement and satisfactory performance. An amount at 5% will be deducted at source from the monthly emoluments as surety. It will be paid back without interest on completion of the contract tenure. If the candidate leaves the company, or the Fixed Term Employment is terminated before the contract tenure is completed, the surety amount will not be returned.

content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Grade 'C' under Fixed Term Employment comprises two stages. Shortlisted candidates must produce all original documents at the time of document verification, including testimonials in support of age and qualification. Appointment is subject to verification of caste, character and antecedents, as the case may be, from the concerned authorities as per company rules. Intimation about the written/practical test will be sent through e-mail and Speed Post. The minimum qualifying marks and test dates are not specified in the notification. Candidates attending the written/practical test will be reimbursed Travelling Allowance (TA), that is III AC Class train fare by the shortest route, on production of proof of travel (original onward journey ticket and photocopy of return journey ticket). If a candidate travels by another mode of transport, the reimbursement is limited to the shortest route by train fare or actual expenses, whichever is less, on production of proof. Candidates who fail to produce the original testimonials/certificates mentioned in the application will not be allowed to appear for the test and no TA will be payable.

content_sections.text: There is no online submission for this recruitment. The company website is used only to download the application format. Applications sent by Fax, E-mail or by hand are not accepted. Log in to the company website (www.ilpgt.com) and download the application format. Fill in the prescribed application form completely, mentioning the name of the post applied for. A valid e-mail ID and mobile number must be entered, as communication about the written/practical test will be sent to them. Affix a passport size photograph at the space provided. Enclose the Demand Draft (Rs.500/- for General, EWS and OBC; Rs.250/- for SC/ST; no fee for PwD) and a set of self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates in proof of qualification, age, category, experience and so on. Place everything in a sealed cover superscribed "Application for the post of ----------". Send it by Ordinary Post, Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier so that it reaches the address below on or before 26.10.2026 (05.00 pm). Candidates can apply for only one post, clearly mentioning the post applied for along with the DD and all other relevant documents. A candidate who has applied once cannot alter the application under any circumstances. Requests for change of mailing address, category or discipline declared in the application will not be entertained. Candidates are advised to keep the e-mail ID active for at least one year and to check e-mail regularly. The company will not be responsible for bounced e-mails. All relevant original certificates must be produced at the time of the written/practical test. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/PWD/Ex-Servicemen/Minority/EWS categories must enclose a copy of the certificate issued by the Competent Authority. The category must be filled in carefully, as it cannot be changed later.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Instrumentation Limited, Palakkad, Kerala, to fill various worker category positions on a fixed term employment basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Instrumentation Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies are available across various trades including Turner, Machinist, Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Electronics Mechanic, and Diesel Mechanic.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an ITI Pass along with a National Apprenticeship Certificate in the relevant trade to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 42 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for Grade 'C' posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary scale ranging from Rs. 14,700 to Rs. 86,000 per month under Grade 'C'.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via postal services.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in applications at the designated office address is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to General, EWS, and OBC categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test carrying 40 marks, a Practical Test carrying 60 marks, and subsequent Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent in a sealed cover to the Manager (P&A), Instrumentation Limited, Kanjikode West, Palakkad-678 623.
